data.name: Ummayah
data.long_meaning: Ummayah is the title given to the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). It signifies their status as the mothers of the believers and their role in guiding and nurturing the faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of compassion, kindness, and maternal love.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Ummayah is governed by the numerology number 6, which represents nurturing, loving, and caring energies. This number is associated with the qualities of a good mother, making it a perfect name for a child who will be nurtured and loved.

in_arabic.name: أميمة
in_arabic.meaning: أميمة تعني الأم أو المرضعة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أميمة مشتق من أمة، يعني الأم أو المرضعة، و يرمز إلى الرعاية و التربية. استخدم في العصر النبوي و له دلالة على أهمية الأمومة و الرعاية في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: امیمہ
in_urdu.meaning: امیمہ کا مطلب ہے ماں یا دائی، عربی زبان سے ماخوذ
in_urdu.long_meaning: امیمہ نام عربی زبان کے 'أميمة' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ماں یا دائی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں استعمال ہوتا تھا اور ماں کی محبت اور پرورش کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उमैमा
in_hindi.meaning: उमैमा का अर्थ है माँ या दाई, अरबी भाषा से लिया गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: उमैमा नाम अरबी भाषा के 'أميمة' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है माँ या दाई। यह नाम मातृत्व और पालन-पोषण के महत्व को दर्शाता है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: اميمه
in_pashto.meaning: اميمه د مور او يا د دايۍ په معنا ده، د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اميمه نوم د عربي ژبې د 'أميمة' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د مور يا د دايۍ په معنا ده. دا نوم د ماتريت او پالنې نښه ده او په افغان او پښتني دود کې کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Ummayah
in_english.meaning: Ummayah means mother or nurse, symbolizing care and nurturing
in_english.long_meaning: Ummayah, derived from Arabic 'أميمة', signifies mother or nurse. It etymologically relates to 'umm', meaning mother. This name holds historical significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the vital role of mothers. It symbolizes care, compassion, and nurturing qualities. In Muslim cultures, Ummayah represents maternal love and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: Ummayah is an Arabic name with profound cultural significance as it is associated with the noble wives of Prophet Muhammad (p.b.u.h.) in early Islamic society. In the early Islamic community, women played critical roles as educators, caretakers, and providers, often serving as heads of households. The title Ummayah signifies the respect and status granted to these individuals based on their merit and contributions to the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, bearing the name Ummayah is an honor written in Islamic history. The name symbolizes the role of the Prophet Muhammad's wives in propagating the teachings of Islam and nurturing the growth of the faith in their community. As the mothers of the believers, they were instrumental in setting examples of faith, piety, and deen (Islamic way of life). Embracing this name is a reminder of the transformative role women continue to play in shaping the spiritual dimension of their households and communities.
